delivery predictability from 65% to 95%. Combines deep technical fluency in .NET, SQL, cloud, and DevOps with strong 
program governance expertise: RAID management, change control, EVM, scope baselines, and stakeholder reporting. 
Recognized for bridging engineering and business strategy — translating complex technical work into executive-level visibility 
while enabling teams to deliver high-quality outcomes consistently.

• Budget & Financial Governance: Manages Fixed Price (FP) and Time & Material (T&M) contracts — develops WBS-

(avoid/transfer/mitigate/accept), and proactively manages cross-team dependencies across distributed squads. 
• Stakeholder & Executive Reporting: Designs data-driven dashboards and governance reports providing real-time 
delivery visibility to senior leadership, steering committees, and client stakeholders. 
• AI-Augmented Delivery: Leverages Generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) for project planning acceleration, 
automated risk summarization, sprint reporting, and delivery forecasting — quantifiably improving PM efficiency.
